integrity: The finite theorem is replayed by two exhaustive traversal directions and two independently coded Bucklin winner implementations; the exact event sets are required to agree before symmetry reduction.
scientific_limitations: Complete only for three candidates, strict complete anonymous ballots, and profiles with unique Bucklin outcomes. The incidence fractions use uniform counting over anonymous profiles and are not empirical voter-model probabilities.
title: Complete six-voter no-show boundary for three-candidate Bucklin voting
